title: Async/Await vs Threads: Event Loops Explained

scenes.line2: Which is right for your code?
scenes.say: Async and threads both tackle concurrency, but how do you pick the right one for your workload?

scenes.label: EventLoop
scenes.sub: Runs tasks cooperatively, ideal for I/O-bound jobs.
scenes.say: Event loops run tasks cooperatively, making async perfect for I/O-bound work like network requests.
Async uses cooperative multitasking, no threads needed. Threads run in parallel and suit CPU-bound or blocking tasks.
In Node.js, async and await use the event loop for non-blocking I/O. Python's asyncio works the same way.

scenes.question: When should you use threads?
scenes.say: Don’t use threads for I/O-bound jobs like network requests. Threads shine for CPU-bound or blocking operations.
